info.title: ControlServer.ProtocolFaultProxy
info.description: A line-level relay in front of ControlServer's onboard NDJSON listener that can lose a chosen kind of DurableAck after the server has committed the message, and close that connection, so an L2 scenario can exercise the onboard's journal replay against the real server (8005-agv-control-server#30); or take the link down on request with nothing lost, so a scenario can watch what each end does with the next session (8005-agv-control-server#31). Every other line is forwarded byte for byte. The relay itself is plain TCP on listenPort; this document covers the HTTP control plane. Loopback only.

get.summary: Liveness, relay listen address and forward target
Current drop plan plus the traffic log: connections (opened, closed, by whom), drops, and one record per line (connection, direction, envelope identity -- never a payload)

put.summary: Arm a plan: drop the next count DurableAcks whose payload.acceptedMessageType matches, closing the connection each time

post.summary: Close every relay connection open right now at both ends, losing no line; the onboard reconnects on its own. Once per commandId: a retry reports the same connections and closes nothing. Moves no revision; the traffic log records closedBy = relay disconnected on request

200.description: Envelope whose body lists the connections closed

post.summary: Start a new round at revision 1 and disarm; the traffic log is kept

expectedRevision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check, skipped on a replay.

count.description: 0 disarms. Each arming is a new plan with its own count.
